table.functionGeneration: v2 request-based Cloud Run; no minimum instances
notes: Published rates checked 2026-11-07. Replace this complete table to select another region. No CUDs.
Daily Firestore quotas modeled as flat daily consumption; uneven bursts require per-day inputs.
Function compute uses Cloud Run request-based quotas, separately from the generic Firebase first-generation table.
Function internet transfer $0.12/GB is a configurable assumption from the generic Firebase table; destination and Cloud Run networking may differ.
Cloud Storage, IAM identity, App Check and auxiliary components remain unpriced until selected; positive unpriced usage cannot be called a complete total.
Firestore storage/PITR/backup hourly prices normalized at 730 hours/month.
